label: Publicjobs
notes: No public JSON API found. Board is server rendered HTML backed by Oleeo Solr search. Build script parses the HTML list at build time.

label: Activelink
notes: No public JSON API found. Board is server rendered Drupal HTML. Build script parses article teasers at build time.

label: RoomPriceGenie
notes: Ashby-hosted board. Build script reads the public Ashby posting API (api.ashbyhq.com/posting-api/job-board/roompricegenie).

label: Pokemon
notes: Greenhouse-hosted board. Build script reads the public Greenhouse boards API (boards-api.greenhouse.io/v1/boards/pokemoncareers/jobs).

label: DRCC
notes: Static HTML page. Build script scrapes the vacancies page for current job listings.

label: RISE Counselling
notes: WordPress site with vacancies on a static page. Build script scrapes the vacancies page for current job listings.

label: Tem
notes: Ashby-hosted board. Build script reads the public Ashby posting API (api.ashbyhq.com/posting-api/job-board/tem).

label: Feeld
notes: Static HTML page. Build script scrapes the careers page for current job listings.

label: Reap
notes: Teamtailor-hosted board. Build script reads the JSON feed (careers.reap.global/jobs.json).

label: Coder
notes: Ashby-hosted board. Build script reads the public Ashby posting API (api.ashbyhq.com/posting-api/job-board/Coder).

label: CoreWeave
notes: Greenhouse-hosted board (coreweaveu). Build script reads the public Greenhouse boards API, filtered to Ireland/EMEA locations only.
